description: This file defines classes and functions for managing gesture history, visualization, and recognition in a Kivy-based GUI application, including GestureHistoryManager, GestureVisualizer, and related components.

classes.name: GestureHistoryManager
classes.description: Manages gesture history, visualization, and recognition interactions within the GUI.

classes.name: RecognizerResultLabel
classes.description: Label subclass for displaying individual recognition results.

classes.name: RecognizerResultDetails
classes.description: Contains a scrollable list of recognition result labels.

classes.name: AddGestureSettings
classes.description: Container for gesture addition settings, inherits from MultistrokeSettingsContainer.

classes.name: GestureSettingsForm
classes.description: Form for configuring and adding new gestures to the recognizer.

classes.name: GestureVisualizer
classes.description: Widget that visualizes a gesture and handles selection/deselection.

methods.name: load_visualizer
methods.description: Loads a visualizer into the form, displaying recognition results.

methods.name: on_touch_down
methods.description: Handles touch events to toggle selection state.

methods.name: _draw_item
methods.description: Draws the gesture on the widget's canvas.

methods.name: on_select
methods.description: Event handler for when the visualizer is selected.

methods.name: on_deselect
methods.description: Event handler for when the visualizer is deselected.

methods.name: reanalyze_selected
methods.description: Reanalyzes the selected gesture using the recognizer.

methods.name: _reanalyze_complete
methods.description: Callback after reanalysis completes, updates UI.

methods.name: add_selected_to_database
methods.description: Adds the selected gesture to the recognition database.

methods.name: visualizer_select
methods.description: Selects a visualizer and loads its data into the form.

methods.name: add_recognizer_result
methods.description: Adds a recognition result visualizer to the history list.
